open_questions: Are there any completed large-scale Phase III randomized controlled trials of microbiome interventions in ICI-treated solid tumour patients?

Are there any ongoing or completed but unpublished Phase III randomized controlled trials of microbiome interventions (FMT, probiotics, defined consortia) combined with immune checkpoint inhibitors in solid tumour patients registered in ClinicalTrials.gov or WHO ICTRP?
需要寻找具体的研究，这些研究必须满足两个条件：1) 从人类 ICI 队列中鉴定出特定的关联菌株；2) 通过实验手段（如无菌小鼠定植该特定分离株、体外共培养或特定代谢物补充）直接验证该菌株对 ICI 疗效的因果功能。目前的材料仅提供了物种水平的临床关联、菌株水平的基因组预测或治疗性益生菌的临床试验，未提供“从人源队列分离并实验验证功能”的直接案例。

This study does not report direct quantification of inosine or other metabolites within human tumor tissue (TME); measurements were restricted to plasma in humans and tumor tissue in mice. There is no comparison of human intratumoral metabolite concentrations versus fecal or plasma samples in ICI-treated patients. The specific methodology for human TME metabolite extraction and quantification remains unaddressed in this text.
research_question: How does the gut microbiome modulate the efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors in solid tumours, and what mechanisms mediate that effect?
